PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

PREFIX kwgr: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/resource/>
PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>

    VALUES ?attribute {
      kwg-ont:NOAAFlood

      kwg-ont:NOAACoastalFlood

    ?place ?property ?value .
  }
  UNION
  {
    # Find geographical places with a specific flood-related observable property.
    # The attribute is the observable property itself.
    # The details are the properties of the observation.
    ?observation sosa:observedProperty ?attribute .
    VALUES ?attribute { kwgr:soilMapUnitObservableProperty.flodfreqdcd }
    ?observation sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest ?place .
    ?place a geo:Feature .
    ?observation ?property ?value .
    FILTER (?property != sosa:observedProperty)

PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX kwg-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/ontology/>
PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/>
PREFIX time: <http://www.w3.org/2006/time#>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?hazard ?damage_property ?damage_value ?place_name ?start_time ?end_time
WHERE {
  ?storm_track a kwg-ont:StormTrack ;
               kwg-ont:hasStormTrack ?noaa_hazard .
  
  ?noaa_hazard kwg-ont:hasPart ?hazard .
  ?hazard a kwg-ont:NOAAHazardEvent .

  ?impact_obs a kwg-ont:ImpactObservation ;
              sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest ?hazard ;
              sosa:observedProperty ?damage_property ;
              sosa:hasSimpleResult ?damage_value .

  ?damage_property rdfs:subClassOf kwg-ont:ImpactObservableProperty .

  ?hazard kwg-ont:spatialRelation ?place .
  ?place rdfs:label ?place_name .
  
  ?hazard kwg-ont:hasTemporalScope ?temporal_entity .
  ?temporal_entity time:hasBeginning ?begin_instant .
  ?begin_instant time:inXSDDateTime ?start_time .
  
  OPTIONAL {
    ?temporal_entity time:hasEnd ?end_instant .
    ?end_instant time:inXSDDateTime ?end_time .
  }
  
  FILTER (?start_time >= "2018-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime && ?start_time < "2019-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime)
}

    kwg-ont:NOAAThunderstormWind
    kwg-ont:NOAATornado
    kwg-ont:NOAATropicalStorm
    kwg-ont:NOAAWinterStorm
    kwg-ont:NOAAMarineThunderstormWind
    kwg-ont:NOAAMarineTropicalStorm
  }

  ?place a kwg-ont:AdministrativeRegion .

                    sosa:hasMember ?impactObs ;
                    sosa:phenomenonTime ?temporalEntity .

  ?impactObs sosa:observedProperty ?damageProperty ;
             sosa:hasSimpleResult ?damageValue .
  ?damageProperty a kwg-ont:ImpactObservableProperty .

  BIND("2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime AS ?queryStartTime)
  BIND("2020-12-31T23:59:59Z"^^xsd:dateTime AS ?queryEndTime)

  OPTIONAL {
    ?temporalEntity a time:Interval .
    ?temporalEntity time:hasBeginning/time:inXSDDateTime ?startTime .

  }
  OPTIONAL {

}

                 coress-ont:hasPublicationType ?publicationType ;
                 coress-ont:dateOfSubmission ?submissionDate ;
                 coress-ont:dateOfPublication ?publicationDate .

    FILTER(?publicationDate >= ?submissionDate)

    BIND(xsd:decimal(REPLACE(REPLACE(STR(?duration), "P", ""), "D", "")) AS ?days)
}
GROUP BY ?publicationType

sparql_query:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX kwg-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/ontology/>
PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX gnis: <http://gnis-ld.org/lod/gnis/ontology/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?place ?placeLabel ?healthAttribute ?value
WHERE {
  {
    # Path 1: For geographical places that are health care facilities, get their direct attributes.
    ?place a/rdfs:subClassOf* kwg-ont:HealthCareFacility .
    ?place ?healthAttribute ?value .
    FILTER(!isBlank(?value))
    FILTER(?healthAttribute NOT IN (rdf:type, geo:hasDefaultGeometry, geo:hasGeometry, kwg-ont:sfWithin, kwg-ont:spatialRelation))
  }
  UNION
  {
    # Path 2: For geographical regions with associated health observations.
    ?collection sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest ?place .
    ?collection a ?collectionType .
    FILTER (?collectionType = kwg-ont:PublicHealthObservationCollection || ?collectionType = kwg-ont:VulnerabilityObservationCollection)
    ?collection sosa:hasMember ?observation .
    ?observation sosa:observedProperty ?healthAttribute .
    ?observation sosa:hasSimpleResult ?value .
  }
  # Optionally retrieve a human-readable label for the place.
  OPTIONAL {
    ?place rdfs:label | gnis:officialName | kwg-ont:hospitalName | kwg-ont:pharmacyName | kwg-ont:publicHealthDepartmentName ?placeLabel .
  }
}

}

PREFIX time: <http://www.w3.org/2006/time#>

  ?impactCollection sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest ?tornado ;

  ?temporalEntity (time:inXSDDateTime|time:hasBeginning/time:inXSDDateTime) ?eventDate .
  FILTER(?eventDate >= "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime && ?eventDate < "2021-01-01T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime)

  ?impactCollection sosa:hasMember ?impactObservation .
  ?impactObservation sosa:observedProperty ?damageProperty ;
                     sosa:hasSimpleResult ?damageValue .
  ?damageProperty rdfs:label ?damagePropertyLabel .

  ?tornado kwg-ont:hasSegment/kwg-ont:startsFrom/geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?tornadoWKT .
  
  ?place a kwg-ont:AdministrativeRegion_3 ;
         geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?placeWKT .
  OPTIONAL { ?place rdfs:label|gnis:officialName ?placeName . }

  FILTER(geof:sfIntersects(?tornadoWKT, ?placeWKT))

PREFIX time: <http://www.w3.org/2006/time#>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX kwgr: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/resource/>

  ?hazardType rdfs:subClassOf* kwg-ont:NOAAHazardEvent .
  FILTER(
    regex(str(?hazardType), "Storm", "i") ||
    regex(str(?hazardType), "Hurricane", "i") ||
    regex(str(?hazardType), "Tornado", "i") ||
    regex(str(?hazardType), "Blizzard", "i") ||
    regex(str(?hazardType), "Typhoon", "i")
  )

  ?obsCollection sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest ?hazard ;
                 sosa:hasMember ?damageObs .
  
  ?damageObs sosa:observedProperty ?damageProperty ;
             sosa:hasSimpleResult ?damageValue .
  
  FILTER(
    ?damageProperty = kwgr:impactObservableProperty.damageCrop ||
    ?damageProperty = kwgr:impactObservableProperty.damageProperty
  )

  ?obsCollection sosa:phenomenonTime ?temporalEntity .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?temporalEntity time:hasBeginning/time:inXSDDateTime ?startTime .
    ?temporalEntity time:hasEnd/time:inXSDDateTime ?endTime .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?temporalEntity time:inXSDDateTime ?startTime .
    BIND(?startTime AS ?endTime)
  }

  OPTIONAL {
    ?hazard kwg-ont:hasSegment ?segment .
    ?segment kwg-ont:startsFrom ?fix .
    ?fix kwg-ont:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?placeWKT .
  }
}

  # Find the associated damage observations and details
  # Using VALUES to specify the desired damage properties

    kwgr:impactObservableProperty.damageCrop
    kwgr:impactObservableProperty.damageProperty
  }

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX kwg-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/ontology/>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?stormType ?property ?value
WHERE {
  VALUES ?rootClass {
    kwg-ont:NOAAHazardEvent
    kwg-ont:StormTrack
  }

  FILTER(
    CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stormType)), "storm") ||
    CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stormType)), "hurricane") ||
    CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stormType)), "tornado") ||
    CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stormType)), "typhoon") ||
    CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stormType)), "thunderstorm") ||
    CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stormType)), "blizzard") ||
    CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stormType)), "wind")
  )
  ?stormType ?property ?value .
  OPTIONAL {
    FILTER(isBLANK(?value))
    ?value owl:onProperty ?onProp .
    FILTER(?onProp IN (kwg-ont:spatialRelation, kwg-ont:sfWithin, geo:hasGeometry))
  }
}
ORDER BY ?stormType ?property

key: sparql-ttl-core_scholar_shallow-0_shot-temp0.0-What publications involve people from more than one department?
competency_question: What publications involve people from more than one department?
sparql_query:
PREFIX coress-ont: <http://example.org/core_scholar_shallow/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?publication
WHERE {
    ?publication coress-ont:submittedBy ?author .
    ?author coress-ont:isPerformedBy ?agent .
    ?agent coress-ont:worksInDepartment ?department .
}
GROUP BY ?publication
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?department) > 1)

key: sparql-nen-kwg_lite-cot-temp0.0-What are all the available damage details that have been impacted by a hazard?
competency_question: What are all the available damage details that have been impacted by a hazard?
sparql_query:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX kwgl-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/lite-ontology/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?damage_property ?domain ?range
WHERE {
  ?damage_property rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty .
  ?damage_property rdfs:domain ?domain .
  ?damage_property rdfs:range ?range .
  FILTER (
    (
      ?domain = kwgl-ont:HazardEvent || ?domain = kwgl-ont:Place
    ) && (
      CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?damage_property)), "damage") || CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?damage_property)), "deaths")
    )
  )
}
ORDER BY ?damage_property

key: sparql-axiom-kwg-cot-temp0.0-What are all the available geographical places and their names?
competency_question: What are all the available geographical places and their names?
sparql_query:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?place ?name
WHERE {
  ?place rdf:type ?class .
  ?class rdfs:subClassOf* geo:Feature .
  ?place rdfs:label ?name .
}
